name: Jephunneh
overview: Jephunneh is a male member of the tribe of Asher, uniquely identified as the son of Jether (also called Ithran) according to 1 Chronicles 7:38. Beyond this genealogical detail, Scripture does not provide further notes about his life or role. His mention serves primarily to establish lineage within the tribe of Asher.
namesAndTitles: The name Jephunneh is a proper name that may mean 'may he [God] turn or turned,' reflecting a possible theophoric element. This name was not given directly by God but is recorded in Scripture. Another name associated in the same genealogical context is Ulla, though its meaning is not provided.
familyAndRelationships: Jephunneh is explicitly identified as the son of Ithran (Jether). Additionally, relationships inferred from the same genealogical passage suggest that Arah, Hanniel, and Rizia may be his ancestors or related family members, though these are not stated as direct parent-child connections. Scripture does not elaborate further on his family beyond these names.
scriptureSignificance: Jephunneh's significance lies in his place within the genealogical records of the tribe of Asher, serving to trace the lineage and heritage of this Israelite tribe. His identification as the son of Jether (Ithran) helps preserve the historical and tribal continuity important for understanding Israel's tribal structure. While not prominent in narrative events, his mention upholds the biblical emphasis on family lines and God's providence in preserving His people through generations.
